title: Panpet Global Enterprise ERP System
short_description: A comprehensive Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) solution for a leading food production company, automating staff management, inventory, production, sales, and financial tracking.
full_description:
Panpet Global Enterprise Limited is a diversified food production company specializing in bread, bottled and sachet water, banana and plantain chips, chin-chin, and other baked goods. With growing operations and an expanding workforce, the company needed a unified digital platform to manage its complex operations efficiently.

Programmers City Software Hub was engaged as the primary technology partner to design, develop, and deploy a comprehensive ERP system tailored to Panpet's unique business processes. The system consolidates multiple operational areas into a single, integrated platform, eliminating manual processes, reducing errors, and providing real-time visibility across the organization.

The ERP solution includes:

• **Staff Management:** Complete employee lifecycle management from onboarding to offboarding, including role-based access control and department management.
• **Attendance & Shift Management:** Automated attendance tracking with shift scheduling and real-time timesheet monitoring.
• **Inventory & Stock Management:** Real-time tracking of raw materials, finished goods, and supplies with automated reorder alerts and stock valuation.
• **Production Management:** Production planning, batch tracking, quality control, and yield optimization.
• **Sales & Logistics:** Order management, customer relationship tracking, delivery scheduling, and fleet management.
• **Financial & Expense Tracking:** Comprehensive accounting, expense tracking, budgeting, and financial reporting with custom dashboards.

**Our Role:** Programmers City Software Hub served as the end‑to‑end software development partner. We architected the system, designed the database schema, developed the frontend and backend, integrated third‑party services, and provided ongoing maintenance and support.

title: Vogue N' Stylish Mobile Applications
short_description: Dual mobile applications for the fashion industry: a comprehensive management app for designers and tailors, and a vibrant marketplace app for the general public to discover and purchase fashion styles.
full_description:
Vogstyl Technology Limited is a digital innovation company creating tailored solutions for the fashion industry. Their flagship products, Vogue N' Stylish Designer and Vogue N' Stylish Marketplace, were conceived to bridge the gap between fashion creators and consumers in the digital age.

Programmers City Software Hub was commissioned to develop both mobile applications from the ground up, creating a connected ecosystem that serves two distinct user groups:

**Vogue N' Stylish Designer:** A comprehensive management application designed specifically for fashion designers, tailors, and fashion houses. The app enables users to manage their entire business operations digitally, including:

• Customer management with detailed measurement tracking and style preferences
• Fabric and material inventory management
• Task assignment and team management for workers
• Style and design catalog creation for public display
• Order management and client communication
• Business analytics and financial tracking

**Vogue N' Stylish Marketplace:** An e-commerce platform where the general public can discover, explore, and purchase fashion styles from designers. Features include:

• Browse and search styles and designs from multiple designers
• View detailed style information including measurements and fabric options
• Place orders and track delivery status
• Secure payment processing
• Customer reviews and ratings
• Personalized recommendations based on preferences

**Our Role:** Programmers City Software Hub served as the lead development partner, architecting the entire system. We designed the API infrastructure, developed both mobile applications, created the admin dashboard, and ensured seamless integration between the two applications and the backend services.

title: Bondlogistics Car Rentals & Sales Platform
short_description: A comprehensive car rental and sales platform serving clients in Atlanta, Georgia, with vehicle listings, online booking, payment integration, and customer relationship management.
full_description:
Bondlogistics LLC is a transportation and logistics company based in Atlanta, Georgia, offering car rental services and vehicle sales to individuals and businesses. With a growing fleet and expanding customer base, the company required a robust digital platform to streamline operations, enhance customer experience, and increase revenue.

Programmers City Software Hub was engaged to design and develop a complete car rental and sales website that serves as a mini e-commerce platform. The solution enables Bondlogistics to showcase their fleet, manage bookings, process payments, and maintain customer relationships efficiently.

The platform features:

**Car Sales:**
• Comprehensive vehicle listings with detailed specifications, images, and pricing
• Search and filter functionality for customers to find their ideal vehicle
• Online inquiry and purchase request forms
• Inventory management for sales staff

**Car Rentals:**
• Real-time vehicle availability tracking
• Online booking and reservation system
• Flexible rental periods with dynamic pricing
• Rental agreement generation and digital signatures
• Automated payment processing and deposit management

**Customer Management:**
• Customer database with rental and purchase history
• Communication and notification system
• Customer support and feedback management
• Loyalty and referral program tracking

**Our Role:** Programmers City Software Hub served as the full‑stack development partner, designing and building the entire platform from scratch. We managed the project from requirements gathering through deployment, and provided training to the client's team.
